title: Retain local complete-Fourfold fixtures after semantic divergence audit

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

scope: Audit only the repeated test-only complete-Fourfold fixture construction named by GPU-77 across tests/twin/test_tensor_forest_cost_probe.py and tests/twin/test_tensor_heldout_csr_probe.py. Determine whether exact plane-completeness, provenance, trace and relation-topology semantics match strongly enough to justify reuse. Do not introduce a shared helper merely to reduce line count, and do not change production projection, public API, probe schemas, benchmark claims, promotion state or branch topology.

relation_cost_fixture.purpose: two-relation relation-cost diagnostic with exact code/knowledge endpoint completeness

heldout_csr_fixture.purpose: held-out multi-hop CSR falsification diagnostic requiring complete code/type/knowledge endpoints

shared_mechanics: derive the legacy Fourfold from the exact Forest
rebuild selected PlaneSnapshot records with status=complete while retaining node/relation/evidence digests
bind fixture provenance to Forest digest, rebuilt plane digests and binding digests
semantic_divergences: The selected complete-plane sets differ: code+knowledge versus code+type+knowledge.
The underlying Forest node-kind domains differ: the relation-cost fixture has no type nodes, while the held-out workload has an explicit type plane.
The relation/binding topology differs: the held-out fixture adds code->type and knowledge->type cross-plane contracts that are absent from the relation-cost workload.
The provenance origins and trace IDs are intentionally workload-specific and therefore part of distinct evidence identities.
The held-out fixture participates in a frozen workload/query-suite falsification surface; the relation-cost fixture belongs to a separate diagnostic construction/query-cost surface.
audit.abstraction_cost: A shared helper would need policy parameters for complete-plane selection plus workload-specific provenance/trace identity. That would convert two small explicit evidence fixtures into a configurable test abstraction whose parameters encode the very semantic differences the audit must keep visible. Moving such a helper into production code would be worse because fixture-only status promotion must not look like a production completeness upgrade path.

decision.reason: The duplicated mechanics are structurally similar but not semantically identical. Exact endpoint completeness, workload topology and provenance/trace identity diverge. Keeping each fixture local is lower-bloat than introducing a configurable test abstraction or a misleading production completeness helper.
decision.summary: Do not consolidate the complete-Fourfold fixtures. Their local explicitness preserves workload-specific endpoint and evidence semantics and avoids cross-test coupling.
